different.songTitle: Don’t Let It Get To You
stanza: All that time spent wondering
How things could be
Completely different
All my presents are broken before they're open
And the promises, the second they're spoken
I know I've been different
My skin keeps shedding
My mother was crying on the day of our wedding
Trumpets of angels call for my head
I fight through the ether and I'll quit when I'm dead
If you want to know who'll be there in the end
When you bury me, baby, I'll still be your friend
Singing

different.line: So how could I expect something different?
stanza: You never could give what I needed then
So how could I expect something different?
It's got to come from me to find a way
Just don't expect me to look back on the good old days

different.line: Maybe that’s just how we’re different
stanza: I don’t mean to be rude
And I’m not in a mood
And even if I was
Well surely that’s only human
Better let it out
With a quick scream and shout
Maybe that’s just how we’re different
That's the way we do things in West Memphis
That's the way we do things in West Memphis
It's never been any different
So don't come around here and try to mess with us
Cause that's the way we do things in West Memphis

different.line: And if your friends think that you should do it different
stanza: And if your friends think that you should do it different
And if they think that you should do it the same

different.songTitle: I Bet You Think About Me (Taylor’s Version) [From the Vault]
different.line: But reality crept in, you said we're too different
stanza: But you know what they say, you can't help who you fall for
And you and I fell like an early spring snow
But reality crept in, you said we're too different
You laughed at my dreams, rolled your eyes at my jokes
Think of all the roads
Think of all their crossings
Taking steps is easy
Standing still is hard
Remember all their faces
Remember all their voices
Everything is different
The second time around

different.line: Besides, maybe this time it's different
stanza: So if you wanna be with me
With these things there's no telling, we just have to wait and see
But I'd rather be working for a paycheck than waiting to win the lottery
Aha, mhm
Besides, maybe this time it's different
I mean, I really think you like me

different.line: Well, didn't know what I was missin', now I see a lil' different
stanza: I didn't know, I didn't know
I didn't know, I didn't know, yeah
Well, didn't know what I was missin', now I see a lil' different
I was, thinkin' too much

different.line: Sour emotions got me lookin' at the universe different
different.linePrev: They got me frustrated, indecisive and power trippin'
different.lineNext: I should distance myself, I should keep it relentless

stanza: Someday drawing you different
May I be weaved in your hair?
In another country
With another name
Maybe things are different
Maybe they're the same

different.line: If one thing had been different
stanza: I, I, I persist and resist the temptation to ask you
If one thing had been different
Would everything be different today?
